links.outcome: Human-AI collaboration effect on pathologist diagnostic workload and micrometastasis detection
links.effect: Human-AI collaboration reduced diagnostic workload by 35%, avoided 105 ancillary tests, and enhanced micrometastasis detection with 87.5% accuracy.
links.quote: Human-AI collaboration further reduced diagnostic workload by 35%, avoided 105 ancillary tests and enhanced detection of micrometastases with 87.5% accuracy.

links.outcome: Model generalization across institutions, tumor types, and anatomical sites, including unseen sites
links.effect: Robust generalization across diverse institutions, tumor types, and anatomical sites, including previously unseen sites and rare cancers, evaluated on more than 15,000 slides from eight centers.
links.quote: The model demonstrated robust generalization across diverse institutions, tumor types, and anatomical sites-including previously unseen sites and rare cancers.

screen.reason: Evaluates a clinical foundation model for intraoperative frozen-section pathology in a prospective clinical deployment cohort of over 2,000 patients, assessing clinical impact and human-AI collaboration on diagnostic workload and test avoidance.

primary.practice: human-AI collaboration in intraoperative pathology workflow
